GENERAL INFORMATION
EQUIPMENT: All Varig flights to and from New York
are flown with four-engined Lockheed Super-G Constel-
lations, piloted by CAA-licensed crews.
BAGGAGE: Free baggage allowance is 30 kilos (66 lbs.)
for first class, and 20 kilos (44 lbs.) for tourist pas-
sen aero.
Overcoats.
umbrellas,
handbags and small
cameras will not be weighed as baggage, but are to be
marked with the passenger's name and address. Excess
weight over free allowance is charged for at 1 percent
of the first class adult one-way fare per kilo, or 2.2 Ibs.
CHILDREN: One child under 2 years of age, when accom-
panied by an adult and not occupying a separate seat,
is carried at 10 percent of the adult fare. Children over
2 and under 12 years, or a child under 2 occupying a
separate seat, are charged one-half of the applicable
adult fare. Children may travel alone only under cer-
tain conditions.
MEALS: All meals in flight are served free, to both first.!
class and tourist passengers.
STOPOVER PRIVILEGES: All passengers flying Varig may
stop at any city enroute, and on the Varig system, if
specified in ticket.
TAXES: Any and all government taxes are in addition
to Varig fares.
INSURANCE:
Trip insurance at low rates is available
through vour travel agent or at any airport.
RESERVATIONS: Passengers must reconfirm their reser-
vations at least 72 hours before departure from any
stopover city.
DEPARTURES: To facilitate on-time departures, passen-
gers are requested to be at the airport one hour before
scheduled take-off time.
GROUND TRANSPORTATION: Taxicab or limousine serv-
ice is available between downtown scheduled check-in
points and airports. This is not a Varig service and is at
passenger's expense.
CONNECTIONS: Flight connections via Varig are avail-
able to all cities with scheduled service.
Your travel
agent, or any Varig office, will arrange these connec
tions for vou.
